blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several areas in Metro Manila and Rizal may experience water service interruption due to the scheduled maintenance works of concessionaire Manila Water Company, Inc. starting Friday evening, Oct. 16. In an advisory, Manila Water said that it will conduct emergency repair and maintenance activities in parts of Pasig City, Quezon City, Taguig
